what: The source half of AC8, written by the develop session that restored the pre-import dump and re-imported the collection through the REWORKED repair file (REQ-007 Decision 9, rework of 2026-08-14). The System Tester never sees the Word documents, so it cannot produce or bend this; it transcribes only what the deployment shows, into signoff.json in the evidence dir. The expectations are recomputed from the ingredient lines below through the committed repair file. This file REPLACES the evidence of the first implementation, whose sign-off was declined: the seam moved, so every expectation it recorded is now wrong.
seam: The food is what you buy, written out in full; what you do with it is the note. Tandoor's shopping list renders amount, unit and food and never the note, so a buying distinction has to be in the food name. Food COUNT is deliberately not graded - the rework trades a longer food list for losing nothing.
